meta.safety: offline research only; never --live; never place orders

baseline_bb_rsi_oos.note: mean-reversion edge collapsed; train-only retrain overfit (OOS PF 0.14)

atr_pctile.definition: percentile rank of atr[i] within atr[i-lookback+1:i+1] inclusive, scale 0–100

donchian.definition: donchian_hi = rolling max(high, N); donchian_lo = rolling min(low, N)

shared_execution.bar: closed H1 only; no same-bar open entry

families.name: Volatility-gated BB/RSI mean reversion
families.thesis: Baseline bb_rsi worked on train (ATR~10, frac>EMA200~0.69) but failed OOS when ATR ~2.4× and trend filter weakened. Edge is train-like calm: only take BB reclaim mean-reversion when atr_pctile is LOW/MED so stops are not blown by expansion regimes. Suppress MR entirely in HIGH vol instead of retuning RSI/SL on the same broken setup.

long: atr_pctile < atr_pctile_max (default 55; allow MED but not HIGH)
close > trend_col (default ema200; optional ema100)
low <= bb_lo and close > bb_lo and close < bb_mid (reclaim lower band)
rsi <= rsi_buy + 10 (default rsi_buy=30 → rsi<=40)
optional: macd_hist > 0 if use_macd_filter
short_optional: high >= bb_up and close < bb_up and close > bb_mid
entry_rules.implement_note: Same reclaim logic as backtest.simulate mode=bb_rsi plus hard atr_pctile gate before signal.

exit_rules.soft_exit_long: rsi >= rsi_sell (default 50–60) close at bar close
exit_rules.hard_invalidation_exit: if atr_pctile crosses above atr_pctile_max while in trade, optional flatten at close (param: exit_on_vol_spike true/false)

filters.trend: close > ema200 (or chosen trend_col) for longs
filters.session: optional hours in {7..16} UTC if n_trades excessive

invalidation: atr_pctile >= atr_pctile_max (do not open MR trades in HIGH vol)
close < ema200 when require_uptrend (no long MR against long-term bias)
bb_width extremely expanded vs recent median (optional: bb_width_pctile > 80 skip)
do not promote if train gates fail or OOS n < 10

families.name: ATR-aware N-bar breakout with EMA trend
families.thesis: 2026 OOS is high-vol expansion (ATR 2.4×, return std 1.85×, less sticky EMA200 bull). Mean reversion is misaligned; trade WITH expansion: break N-bar highs only when atr_pctile is HIGH/MED and price is above a trend EMA, with wider ATR stops so noise does not stop out the move.

long: atr_pctile >= atr_pctile_min (default 60; prefer HIGH expansion)
close > ema_trend (default ema50 or ema100)
close > max(high[i-N:i])  i.e. close breaks prior N-bar high (exclude current bar)
optional confirmation: close > open (bullish close) or macd_hist > 0
rsi not overbought extreme: rsi < rsi_max (default 75) to avoid late chase
short_optional: if long_only=false: symmetric break of N-bar low with close < ema_trend and atr_pctile high
entry_rules.implement_note: donchian_hi_prev = rolling_max(high, N).shift(1); long if close > donchian_hi_prev and filters pass.

exit_rules.trail_optional: after +1R, trail SL to entry or to close - trail_atr*ATR
exit_rules.soft_exit: close < ema20 (trend failure) or rsi soft_exit_level (optional)

filters.vol_percentile: atr_pctile >= atr_pctile_min (trade expansion, not calm chop)
filters.trend: close > ema50 (or ema100); optional ema20 > ema50 stack

invalidation: atr_pctile < atr_pctile_min (no breakout entries in LOW vol)
close below ema_trend (no long breakout against local trend)
rsi >= rsi_max (late momentum)
inside-bar / failed break (close back inside N-range next bar → skip re-entry until new extreme)
if train MaxDD > 10% or PF < 1.5 after grid, abandon family

families.name: EMA pullback continuation (trend, not fade)
families.thesis: When a bullish structure still exists (EMA stack or close>ema200), buy shallow pullbacks to ema20/ema50 with RSI not oversold-extreme (continuation, not deep dip-buy). Works across dual regimes if pullbacks are measured in ATR and mid-vol filter avoids both dead chop and chaotic spikes. Aligns with macd_pullback mode spirit in backtest.py but with explicit structure + optional atr_pctile mid band.

long: structure: close > ema200 OR (ema20 > ema50 and ema50 > ema100) per stack_mode
pullback: low <= ema_pull + atr_buffer*ATR and close >= ema_pull - 0.25*ATR (touch/near pullback MA)
recovery: close > open OR close > prior close (reclaim after touch)
rsi in [rsi_lo, rsi_hi] e.g. 40–60 (not extreme; not deep MR)
optional: macd_hist rising (macd_hist[i] > macd_hist[i-1]) or hist cross up through 0
optional: atr_pctile in [pct_lo, pct_hi] mid band (default 30–75)
short_optional: mirror under close < ema200 with pullback to ema20/50 from below
entry_rules.implement_note: ema_pull in {ema20, ema50}; prefer touch of ema20 in strong trend, ema50 in broader trend.

exit_rules.soft_exit: rsi >= rsi_sell (default 65–70) or close < ema_pull (structure break)
exit_rules.sl_placement: entry - sl_atr*ATR, or min(low of pullback bar, ema_pull) - 0.2*ATR if tighter and still >= 1.0 ATR

filters.trend: ema stack or close > ema200 required

invalidation: no structure (close < ema200 and stack broken)
rsi < rsi_lo (too deep — becomes mean-rev, use other family)
rsi > rsi_hi at entry (already extended)
atr_pctile outside mid band if mid filter enabled
consecutive lower lows breaking ema50 after entry → soft exit only, no add

families.name: Dual-regime switch (breakout if HIGH vol else mean-rev)
families.thesis: Single-mode bb_rsi cannot span train calm and 2026 expansion. Explicit switch: if atr_pctile HIGH → atr_breakout_trend rules with wide stops; else → vol_gate_meanrev (or milder BB reclaim). One position engine, two entry modules, shared risk. Addresses structural regime shift without continuous param thrashing.

entry_rules.regime_split: HIGH if atr_pctile >= high_thresh else LOW_MED

mode_low_med_vol.name: meanrev_module
rules: low <= bb_lo and close > bb_lo and close < bb_mid

entry_rules.conflict: never fire both; HIGH module has priority if both true (should not overlap by construction)

exit_rules.note: store entry_mode on fill; apply that mode's SL/TP/soft for the life of the trade

filters.vol_percentile: defines module; no third 'off' state by default (optional off if atr_pctile in [high_thresh-5, high_thresh+5] deadband)

invalidation: module-specific invalidations inherit from atr_breakout_trend / vol_gate_meanrev
optional deadband: do not trade when |atr_pctile - high_thresh| < deadband
if one module produces >80% of trades and fails OOS alone, switch is not dual — redesign weights
WF fold pass rate 0 and holdout fail → do not live-promote

families.name: HTF Fib golden-zone proxy (H4 pivots on H1)
families.thesis: Alternate structural thesis from scripts/htf_fib_offline_backtest.py: confirmed H4 swing pivots define directional Fib 61.8–78.6 golden zone; enter with trend (EMA200 bias) when H1 closes in zone with RSI not extreme. Less dependent on train-like BB width; can work in dual regimes if swings are valid. Existing offline path is sparse/strict — specs relax RSI-MA and widen ATR exits for XAU high vol.

structure: Build H4 OHLC from H1 resample 4h
Confirmed pivots left=right=P (default 5) on H4 high/low
Walk swings → direction +1/-1, f618, f786 as in walk_swing_and_fibs
Map fib state forward onto H1 bars
long: direction == +1
close > ema200
min(f618,f786) <= close <= max(f618,f786) (in golden zone)
rsi <= rsi_long_max (default 40; grid 35–45)
optional use_rsi_ma: rsi > sma(rsi,14)
edge trigger: prior bar was not already a valid long signal (first touch / re-entry edge)
entry_rules.implement_note: Port run_backtest() from htf_fib_offline_backtest.py; add atr_pctile optional filter and XAU contract sizing.

exit_rules.soft_exit: leave zone against direction for 2 consecutive closes, or RSI soft cross
exit_rules.reverse_on_flip: if opposite fib signal, exit and reverse (as offline script) or flat-only (prefer flat-only for risk control)

invalidation: no valid swing / fib (direction==0 or nan fibs) — no trade
close on wrong side of ema200 vs direction
outside golden zone
RSI outside allowed band
offline/EURUSD-style ultra-strict confluence yielding n_trades << 20 on train → relax RSI-MA first, do not force live

families.name: Donchian channel trend-follow with ATR stops
families.thesis: Classic channel breakout is the simplest high-vol compatible trend family: buy strength above upper Donchian, exit on opposite channel or ATR stop. Distinct from atr_breakout_trend by using channel mid/exit rules (Turtle-style) rather than fixed TP only, and by optional ATR-expansion confirmation. Suited when frac>EMA200 is unstable but short-term range expansion carries.

long: close > donchian_hi_entry where entry_N default 20: close breaks prior entry_N high
optional: atr_pctile >= 50 (expansion bias)
optional: close > ema100 filter to reduce pure whipsaw
optional: ADX-proxy simple: (ema20-ema50)/atr > adx_proxy_min OR |close-close.shift(20)|/atr > 3
short_optional: close < donchian_lo_entry (prior entry_N low) with mirror filters
entry_rules.implement_note: donchian_hi_entry = high.rolling(entry_N).max().shift(1); exit_channel = low.rolling(exit_N).min().shift(1) for longs.

exit_rules.channel_exit: long exits when close < donchian_lo_exit (exit_N default 10) OR low <= SL
exit_rules.tp_note: prefer channel/trail over fixed TP; optional tp_atr 4.0 as cap
exit_rules.trail: SL = max(SL, close - trail_atr*ATR) once in profit by 1R

invalidation: atr_pctile < atr_pctile_min when filter on
whipsaw regime: too many channel flips within 48 bars → widen entry_N or stand down
if train WR < 45% and PF < 1.2, channel too noisy for this XAU sample
never trade without closed-bar confirmation (no stop-entry on high alone)

order: Implement atr_pctile + donchian helpers on indicators() in offline backtest only
Grid each family on train split only (<2026-01-02); select by gates then train net
Evaluate frozen params on holdout OOS; require n>=10 preferred
Walk-forward (expanding) with per-fold train-only select; fold pass rate target >=50%
Compare families; do not blend until single family passes
